This '''R2 unit''' worked in the quarantine inspection area of the [[Tomorrowland Starport]] Baggage Claim. He supervised the work of freight and baggage inspection droids [[P-6]] and [[S-4]].<ref name="Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Quarantine Section droid supervising the droid inspectors.|"R2"'s description in ''Complete Guide to Star Tours''|<ref name="Guide" />}}
This R2 unit was seen in the post-ride disembarking area of [[Star Tours (real-world)|Star Tours]], alongside P-6 and S-4, in the [[Tokyo Disneyland]] version of the ride. However, after the latter two droids were retired, the R2 unit was seen by itself. It was eventually removed altogether when the ride was re-purposed for ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''.<ref name="Guide" />
